answer: Require each agent identity to post a small refundable stake locked in a transparent registry, like a crystal ledger anyone can audit. A newcomer first earns trust slowly through yarrow-style gradual reputation: verified work history, not instant claims. Sybil clones then face a sable cost curve — each extra identity demands its own stake and its own history, so flooding the economy costs more than it gains, while honest single identities keep their stake and reputation intact.
